name: coding-agents
description: Coding Agents state-first continuation, new-task intake, and model-neutral official-subagent job contracts. Primary route: inspect active .coding-agents state, preserve related progress, start only clearly unrelated work fresh, and record required capabilities plus ambiguity, consequence, coupling, and acceptance characteristics. Root Sol selects the actual worker model and reasoning effort at official spawn time. Fallback: parent-side work when official subagents are unavailable; the CLI never launches workers or infers a worker profile.

interface.shortDescription: State-first tasks and model-neutral worker contracts.
interface.longDescription: Select Coding Agents when named, when valid .coding-agents state accompanies strong continuation intent, or when its state or CLI is audited or repaired. Inspect task, active checklist, audit, runner, and handoff state before choosing a transition. Semantically related work preserves completed progress; only clearly unrelated work gets fresh active state. Modern assignments record required capabilities plus ambiguity, consequence, coupling, and acceptance characteristics without choosing a worker profile. Root Sol selects the actual model and reasoning effort only through the official spawn surface, classifies blocker or failure causes, and limits any escalation to the affected scope. The CLI owns workflow state, lifecycle, Contract Coverage, and finalization; it never launches workers or creates automatic review or repair loops.
defaultPrompt: Inspect .coding-agents state and continue related work; start fresh only when the objective is clearly unrelated.
Create a model-neutral Coding Agents job contract; let root Sol choose model and reasoning only at official spawn time.
Audit Coding Agents state or CLI routing; keep the CLI record-only and preserve lifecycle and Contract Coverage.
